ImageDescription.value:
Ontos leads commandeered vehicles during the Battle for Hue City, 1968. The Ontos is spearheading the effort to MedEvac and resupply Marines.

From the 1st Marine Division, Press Releases and Photographs: 1966-1971 Collection (COLL/4932), United States Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections.

Artist.value: USMC Archives from Quantico, USA
